name: 褶皱（背斜/向斜/轴面）分析

map.输入两翼产状（倾向与倾角）。由两翼法向 n₁、n₂ 求枢纽（褶皱轴）= n₁×n: Enter the attitude of the two limbs (dip direction and dip angle). From the limb normals n₁ and n₂, the hinge (fold axis) = n₁×n₂, and the axial-plane normal is taken as n₁−n₂ orthogonalised to the hinge; then the axial-plane dip direction and dip angle are converted. The interlimb angle = 180° − arccos(n₁·n₂) is used to classify tight/close/open/gentle; the axial-plane dip angle distinguishes upright/inclined/recumbent.

map.地质填图与野外判读中，由实测两翼产状反求枢纽（褶皱轴）与轴面产状，用于确定褶皱的: In geological mapping and field interpretation, the hinge (fold axis) and axial-plane attitude are back-solved from the measured limb attitudes to determine the spatial attitude of the fold.
map.构造地质教学里用两翼产状演示对称褶皱与不对称褶皱的轴面差异，以及翼间角对应的紧闭: In structural geology teaching, the limb attitudes demonstrate the axial-plane difference between symmetric and asymmetric folds and the tightness corresponding to the interlimb angle.
map.剖面绘制前先核算轴面倾向与倾角，保证剖面图上的褶皱形态与实测数据一致。: Before drawing a section, check the axial-plane dip direction and angle to keep the fold shape on the section consistent with the measured data.
map.两翼输入「西翼,270,30」与「东翼,90,60」，求得翼间角 90.0°、轴: With the two limbs entered as "West limb,270,30" and "East limb,90,60", the interlimb angle is 90.0°, the axial-plane dip angle 75.0°, the axial-plane dip direction 90.0° and the hinge horizontal (plunge 0.0°); the 30.0° difference in limb dip marks it as asymmetric, the axial plane as inclined and the tightness as open.
map.需要几行输入？: How many input lines are needed?
map.至少两行，工具取前两行作为两翼；两翼产状平行时无法构成褶皱，会给出提示。: At least two; the tool takes the first two lines as the limbs. Parallel limb attitudes cannot form a fold and a prompt is shown.
map.翼间角两翼倾角有什么关系？: What is the relation between the interlimb angle and the limb dip angles?
map.当两翼倾向正好相反时，翼间角等于 180° 减去两翼倾角之和；倾向不正交时工具按: When the two limb dip directions are exactly opposite, the interlimb angle equals 180° minus the sum of the limb dip angles; when the directions are not orthogonal the tool computes the normal-angle precisely.
map.能判断背斜还是向斜吗？: Can it tell an anticline from a syncline?
map.仅凭两翼产状无法区分，需结合核部与两翼地层的新老关系；本工具只做几何求解，输出轴: The limb attitudes alone cannot distinguish them; the age relation between the core and limb strata is needed. This tool only solves the geometry, outputting the axial-plane attitude, interlimb angle and symmetry as geometric parameters.
